, a day after announcing a deal to ease sanctions on Russian diesel exports.
Trump Says Ukraine Needs New President

"I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal because he could have made many deals, but for some reason, he never does," Trump said to reporters at the White House, according to a Reuters report. "I think it’s time for Ukraine to get a new president."
Trump made the comment

params.linkText: one day after he announced the deal

children: . On Saturday, Russia said it had partially lifted its ban on diesel exports. The change took effect immediately.
Trump’s remarks also follow strong criticism of the deal from Zelenskyy.
Zelenskyy said Russia had responded to the sanctions relief by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia. The strike killed 20 people, including three children.
It was the third mass-casualty attack on Ukraine this week. Nearly 80 civilians were killed in strikes on Wednesday and Thursday.
Trump Warns Ukraine to Stop Strikes on Russian Oil Refineries
Trump also criticized Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries. He said the attacks have pushed up global prices. "He better damn well stop," Trump said.

Kyiv wants all energy strikes by both sides to end. In September, it said it was ready to halt strikes on Russian territory if allies could secure a genuine Russian commitment not to hit Ukraine’s critical infrastructure.

Vladimir Putin
said peace talks were unlikely to resume right away. He pointed to Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow.
